extra_life_amounts {"1234": 3.141, "9999": 9999}
join hortbot 99 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test "(_COMMAND_test2_)"
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test2 (_EXTRALIFE_AMOUNT_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set extralifeid 1234
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "$3.14"


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add rec1 A (_COMMAND_rec2_) A
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add rec2 B (_COMMAND_rec1_) B
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!rec1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] A B (error) B A


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test "(_COMMAND_what_)"
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] ""

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list add hello
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test (_COMMAND_hello_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] (error)
